authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: "If (after making the above adjustments) the minimum-integer-part-size and the minimum-fractional-part-size are both zero, then the minimum-fractional-part-size is set to 1 (one)". minimum-integer-part-size stays 0, so the leading zero is not written and the result begins with the decimal-separator.
